title: Workspace dependency lock alignment
objective: Ensure all required runtime and dev dependencies from PLAN-A are present and pinned coherently in the root workspace metadata.
implementation_steps: Audit root pyproject.toml against PLAN-A dependency list (sympy>=1.12, numpy>=1.24, opt-einsum>=3.3, taichi>=1.7, pyyaml>=6.0)
Verify mechdsl-core/pyproject.toml has all required runtime deps
Run uv lock to regenerate lock file if needed
Run uv sync --frozen to verify clean environment resolution
acceptance_criteria: uv sync --frozen succeeds in a clean environment
All PLAN-A runtime dependencies are present and version-pinned
risks: Taichi version pinning may conflict with other deps — no plan mitigation provided
